agent_manual_start_updating: {computer} is updating. Wait for the update to finish.
agent_manual_start_offline_you: {computer} is offline. Open CoForge on it first.
agent_manual_start_offline_other: {computer} is offline. Ask {owner} to open CoForge on it.
agent_manual_start_unusable_you: {runtime} on {computer} cannot run the Agent. Reinstall or update it first.
agent_manual_start_unusable_other: {runtime} on {computer} cannot run the Agent. Ask {owner} to reinstall or update it.
agent_manual_start_unconfirmed_you: {computer} has not reported {runtime} yet. Check that CoForge is running there.
agent_manual_start_unconfirmed_other: {computer} has not reported {runtime} yet. Ask {owner} to check that CoForge is running there.
agent_manual_start_missing_you: No usable {runtime} on {computer}. Install it first.
agent_manual_start_missing_other: No usable {runtime} on {computer}. Ask {owner} to install it.
agent_readiness_computer_updating: {computer} is updating. It will resume on its own when the update finishes.
agent_readiness_computer_offline_you: {computer} is offline. Open CoForge on it and the Agent will resume.
agent_readiness_computer_offline_other: {computer} is offline. {owner} needs to open CoForge on it before the Agent can resume.
agent_readiness_runtime_missing_you: No usable {runtime} on {computer}. The Agent will resume once it's installed.
agent_readiness_runtime_missing_other: No usable {runtime} on {computer}. {owner} needs to install it before the Agent can resume.
agent_readiness_runtime_unusable_you: {runtime} on {computer} is installed but can't run the Agent. Reinstall or update it and the Agent will resume.
agent_readiness_runtime_unusable_other: {runtime} on {computer} is installed but can't run the Agent. {owner} needs to reinstall or update it before the Agent can resume.
agent_readiness_runtime_unconfirmed_you: {computer} hasn't reported {runtime} yet. The Agent will resume once it does.
agent_readiness_runtime_unconfirmed_othe: {computer} hasn't reported {runtime} yet. {owner} needs to check that CoForge is running on it.
agent_readiness_runtime_unknown_other: {computer} can't run {runtime} right now. {owner} needs to check it before the Agent can resume.
agent_readiness_login_other: Ask the computer owner or an administrator to sign in to {runtime} on {computer}.
agent_readiness_launch_unavailable: The availability of {runtime} on {computer} couldn't be confirmed.
agent_readiness_launch_private: {runtime} on {computer} hasn't been shared with the Agent owner.
agent_readiness_launch_version_too_old: {runtime} on {computer} is too old and needs an update.
agent_readiness_launch_model_not_found: {runtime} on {computer} can't use this model. Pick another model and start again.
agent_readiness_launch_auth_failed: Authentication failed during startup. Check the logs for details.
agent_readiness_launch_authorization_fai: This computer could not complete Agent startup authorization with CoForge.
agent_readiness_launch_provider_not_conf: The model provider isn't set up. Fix it and start again.
agent_readiness_launch_environment_inval: One of the Agent's environment variables can't be used. Fix it and start again.
agent_readiness_launch_restart_limit: It used up its automatic restarts after stalling.
